title: Workflow Rules | "Priority changed" no longer runs when a ticket is created (Execution History, one test ticket)
notes: Rule "Create or Edit + Priority changed": ran once, trigger On Edit, when Priority was changed Low → High. No run when the ticket was created (expected).
Control rule "On Create" with no condition: ran on create, so rules were being evaluated for this ticket and the missing runs are real.
Rule "On Create + Priority changed": no row at all for this ticket (expected; before the fix it ran on every new ticket).

Also checked by API on 24 Nov: On Create + Priority changed with ticket created High / Medium / Low, and On Create + Subject changed, did not run; On Edit + Priority changed ran on the priority edit and not on another field's edit.
